dedupe_keys.name: awebox airborne wind energy control toolkit

description: AWEbox is a Python toolkit for modelling and optimal control of airborne wind-energy systems. It formulates trajectories for one or more tethered kites, including rigid-wing lift and drag modes, and supports model-predictive control design. Inputs are kite and tether parameters, wind conditions, constraints and objective settings; outputs are optimised trajectories and simulated control responses. The operating site, spatial path and time horizon are user-defined. Source is free under LGPL-3.0, while CasADi and the IPOPT solver are required dependencies; HSL solvers are recommended but optional and have separate access terms. A limitation is that numerical optimisation and aerodynamic assumptions require care for hardware-specific operation, and the examples are not proof of flight safety. AWEbox can support wind-generation technology design and testing. It is related to wind-farm analysis tools, though it models airborne devices, not fixed turbines. No optimisation case was run.
